patches.value: Under L1, ||Pgt_N Ctri_[a,t](e,g,V)||_2+||Pgt_N Ctri_[a,t](v,v,e)||_2<=C_(gamma,M0)*h*tau^gamma+C_(gamma,M0)*(h+N^(-pstar))*E_I uniformly for t in I.

Under L1, F_I(t)=(1/3)[J_s(e,g)]_a^t-(1/3)Ctri_[a,t](e,g,V)-(1/6)Ctri_[a,t](v,v,e)+(1/3)integral_a^t J_s(Rres',V)ds. The sum of the norms of Pgt_N J_t(e,g) and Pgt_N J_a(e,g) is <=C_(gamma,M0)*N^(-1)*E_I.

Under L1, sup_I||Pgt_N F_I||_2<=C_(gamma,M0)*(h+tau)*tau^gamma+C_(gamma,M0)*(h+tau+N^(-1)+N^(-pstar))*E_I, and E_I<=||e(a)||_2+C_(gamma,M0)*(h+tau)*tau^gamma+C_(gamma,M0)*(N^2*h+h+tau+N^(-1)+N^(-pstar))*E_I, with one constant depending only on gamma,M0.
